about.title: 01 // Background
about.heading: Closing the gap between rigid logic and organic expression.
about.p1: Hey. I'm Angie Plazas, a transdisciplinary Fullstack Developer operating at the intersection of generative art, creative coding, mathematics, and modern web engineering. I build immersive digital experiences that translate ideas into interaction.
about.p2: As a creative coder, I work with JavaScript, P5.js, WebGL, Three.js, and React, alongside raw mathematical algorithms and scientific material from my lab and surroundings, to build interactive experiences that blur the line between utility and art. I think of myself as an explorer of complexity: I take difficult systems and make them creative. I'm gradually integrating agents and generative AI into this approach.
about.p3: I'm fascinated by thinking of code as a living system: being able to follow its patterns, alter its rules, and leave space to explore what might emerge beyond what was planned. In that small drift, almost entropic, I usually find part of my creative process.
